# Can Nickeil Alexander-Walker REPEAT His Fantasy PLAYOFF Heroics Next Year?

Locked On Fantasy Basketball, 2026-07-14, 29:06. https://youtu.be/xHRF06_E9HE

## Summary

Josh Lloyd looks at players who jumped the most in per-game rankings after the trade deadline. His window starts Monday, February 9, and he asks which gains can carry into next season. He thinks Nickeil Alexander-Walker (top 50), Cooper Flagg (second round) and Darius Garland (worth it around picks 70 to 80) can come close to repeating, because their teams and roles are mostly unchanged. He calls the jumps by Kyle Filipowski, Reed Sheppard, Maxime Raynaud and Gui Santos largely fake. Their teams were missing players or shutting guys down, and their rosters are now healthier or deeper. Matas Buzelis gets a cautious top 50-ish projection. He then quickly dismisses many other late-season risers whose numbers came from tanking teams and injuries.
